steps.title: Update App Package & Metadata
steps.description: Configure package name to com.bhagwatistock.app and update app branding across project metadata files.

steps.title: Update Gradle Build Configuration
steps.description: Configure applicationId and namespace to com.bhagwatistock.app with Java 8 compatibility in build.gradle.

steps.title: Update Android Manifest & Provider Authority
steps.description: Declare permissions, activities, and FileProvider authority for com.bhagwatistock.app in AndroidManifest.xml.

steps.title: Configure App Resources & Theme Palette
steps.description: Define color palette, Material themes, and text string resources for Bhagwati Stock inventory management.

steps.title: Implement Scan Data Model
steps.description: Create ScanModel data structure for managing OCR scanner log entries and character metrics.

steps.title: Implement Mobile Inventory Model
steps.description: Build MobileModel data class with dual IMEI validation, model specs, pricing, and stock status fields.

steps.title: Implement Inventory Log Model
steps.description: Build InventoryLogModel class for tracking stock movement, intake operations, sales, and edit history.

steps.title: Implement SQLite Database Layer
steps.description: Create ScanHistoryDbHelper for managing SQLite tables, schema migrations, duplicate IMEI checks, and inventory queries.

steps.title: Implement Mobile OCR Spec Parser
steps.description: Implement MobileOcrParser engine to extract brand, model, IMEI, serial number, RAM, ROM, and color from raw text.

steps.title: Implement ZIP Backup & Restore Engine
steps.description: Build BackupHelper to create and restore compressed ZIP archives of database records and shared preferences.

steps.title: Implement History Adapter Component
steps.description: Build HistoryAdapter to handle clipboard copy, sharing, and rendering scan history items in ListView.

steps.title: Build Main Dashboard Controller
steps.description: Implement MainActivity for display of inventory summary metrics, recent stock intakes, OCR triggers, and backup controls.

steps.title: Build Live ML Kit Camera Scanner Activity
steps.description: Implement CameraScanActivity for real-time ML Kit OCR text recognition and ZXing barcode reading with flashlight toggle.

steps.title: Build Mobile Intake & Edit Form
steps.description: Implement AddEditMobileActivity for manual data entry, automatic OCR spec parsing, and validation of dual 15-digit IMEIs.

steps.title: Build Stock In Management View
steps.description: Implement StockInActivity for searching, filtering, and managing incoming mobile stock entries.

steps.title: Build Stock Out & Sales Activity
steps.description: Implement StockOutActivity to select available inventory, capture customer details, and process device sales.

steps.title: Build All Inventory & Audit Log Screens
steps.description: Implement AllMobilesActivity, HistoryActivity, and ResultActivity for comprehensive inventory management and audit log tracking.

steps.title: Building Bhagwati Stock
steps.description: Compile project resources and assemble debug APK for Bhagwati Stock app.
